spielzeug-angebote.h: Toy Deals: LEGO, Playmobil, Carrera & more
spielzeug-angebote.intro: Toy deals on LEGO, Playmobil, Carrera, Hot Wheels, board games and more in Germany – checked discounts, great for birthdays and Christmas.
tips: Popular sets often sell out before Christmas – buy early when the price is good.
Check the age rating, especially small parts for children under 3.
For race tracks and RC cars, check whether batteries are included.
Retired sets often get more expensive afterwards.

windeln-angebote.intro: Pampers diapers, pants and wipes in bulk packs with checked discounts. What counts is the price per diaper.
tips: Always compare the price per diaper, not per pack.
Big packs only pay off if the size still fits for a few weeks.
Pants are handy once your child won't keep still during changing.
Amazon Subscribe & Save often adds a few percent off.

rasierklingen.h: Razor Blade Deals: Gillette, OneBlade & more
rasierklingen.intro: Replacement blades from Gillette (Fusion5, Labs, Mach3) and Philips OneBlade with checked discounts – bulk packs are especially worth it.
tips: Compare the price per blade – large packs are usually much cheaper.
Blades only fit their own system, e.g. Fusion5 blades on Fusion5 handles.
Store blades dry so they last longer.
Gillette starter packs with a handle often cost about the same as blades alone.

speicherkarte.intro: microSD and SD cards from SanDisk, Samsung and others with checked discounts – including microSD Express for Nintendo Switch 2.
tips: Switch 2 needs microSD Express; regular microSD cards only work there for screenshots and videos.
For 4K video, look for U3 or V30.
For cameras and drones, write speed matters most.
Buy from known retailers – fake cards are a real problem.

powerbank.intro: Power banks from Anker and other brands with checked discounts – from small 10,000 mAh packs to laptop power banks.
tips: For laptops, plan at least 65 W over USB-C.
10,000 mAh is usually enough for one or two phone charges.
Power banks up to 100 Wh are generally allowed in carry-on luggage – check your airline's rules.
Jump starter power banks for cars are their own category and also charge phones.

fernseher-43-zoll.intro: 43-inch TVs from TCL, Samsung, Amazon and others with checked discounts – ideal for bedrooms, kitchens or small living rooms.
tips: At 43 inches, 4K pays off from about 1–1.5 m viewing distance.
Check the operating system (Google TV, Fire TV, Tizen) – it decides which apps you get.
For gaming look for HDMI 2.1 or 120 Hz – few 43-inch models have it.
Small TVs often sound thin – a soundbar helps.
